dataset.revision_status: Not pinned in the historical download; current upstream revision is not backfilled

scope.evaluation_type: Historical local API-based evaluation on public data; multiple development iterations
scope.accuracy_rule: Nonempty locally extracted A/B/C/D prediction equals expected choice; all attempts stay in denominator
scope.parser: Full and 82 runs: extract_choice(content) or extract_choice(reasoning); broader than the original 10-case final-content-only pilot
scope.missing_or_context_rejected: No successful task answer; reported separately from wrong choices
scope.shared_predictions: Harness direct_pass reuses cached Direct answers; the paths are not independent draws
scope.lengths: chars/4 estimates and cached prompt-token usage are not raw-source tokenizer measurements; cached usage can combine recovery requests
scope.reported_calls: Historical client counters, not an audited physical-attempt ledger
scope.included: Derived sample metadata, letter predictions, counters, context hashes, and artifact hashes only
scope.excluded: Source text, questions, option text, reasoning, request traces, private endpoints, credentials, absolute local paths

pilot_10.stage: Initial routing check; different answer-channel policy from subsequent full run
